tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find companies in Slovakia, Czechia and Romania by name or registration number. Returns the basic facts and the registration number to use with the other tools.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: The basic company card from the public register: name, legal form, status, seat, main activity, VAT payer flag, with provenance. Free.

tools.name: check_vat
tools.description: Live VAT risk before paying a supplier: SK §81 list and published accounts, CZ unreliable VAT payer (§109) and published accounts, RO inactive taxpayer. Stored as a verification record (see get_record). Costs credits.

tools.name: get_risk
tools.description: Debts to the state, tax reliability, insolvency proceedings and a rule-based score with its reasons (not a credit rating). Costs credits.

tools.name: verify_company
tools.description: KYB: verify a legal entity as a customer or partner in one call: the register card (identification), the register status (verification), the live VAT checks and the EU / OFAC sanctions lists, with a verdict for your review (clear, review, unavailable). Stored as a verification record. Does not cover

tools.name: screen_name
tools.description: Screen a company name outside the Karpata index (a counterparty from any country) against the EU consolidated sanctions list and the US OFAC SDN list, legal entities only; optional ISO country and identifiers. A possible match is a lead to review, not a verdict. Stored as a verification record. Cost

tools.name: get_financials
tools.description: Financial statements for up to five years with ratios (SK, CZ, RO). Costs credits.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: A stored VAT check (verification record) by its id, with whether its content still matches its SHA-256.

tools.name: list_watched
tools.description: The companies your organization watches, with their current state (register status, debtor and VAT lists), the plan's watch limits and the last 200 changes detected since watching started. Free.

tools.name: watch_company
tools.description: Start watching a company: Karpata compares it with the registers and lists every hour and records every change (status, debtor lists, VAT lists, insolvency). Idempotent. Limited by the plan's number of watched companies; free.

tools.name: unwatch_company
tools.description: Stop watching a company. Idempotent; free.
